title: A customer paid. Why is the invoice still open?
status: review-ready; agentic-angle revision independently reviewed; not operator-approved or published
visibility: internal review artifact; excluded from external publication payloads

evidence_ledger.supports: A proposed reconciliation route for already-received money, with permitted actions, confirmation, and no new money movement.

evidence_ledger.type: cleared public payment-semantics and workflow evidence
evidence_ledger.supports: Received, matched, remaining, and settled are distinct; an exact partial payment can leave an invoice open; uncertain updates and contact eligibility require a hold or current-context check.

claims.text: Before a payment reminder, the agent checks the confirmed payment source, invoice and agreed terms, prior allocations, and current promise, dispute, and contact context.
For a hypothetical $1,000 invoice with a confirmed $400 matched payment and no earlier payments or adjustments, $600 remains.
assumptions: The payment belongs to the invoice.
There are no earlier payments or adjustments.

claims.text: A clear supported match can record already-received money, verify the remaining invoice balance, and update a cash/follow-up view without treating the invoice as fully paid or creating a new charge.
An ambiguous payment or uncertain attempted update stays unresolved while the agent asks a focused question or checks current state before retrying.

A routine reminder is sent only when owner rules and the latest payment, promise, dispute, and recent-contact context permit it; otherwise the case pauses for the owner’s decision and resumes with a fresh state check.
The proposed agent verifies the cash/follow-up updates and inspects the delivery result of an authorized reminder; unfinished updates or unconfirmed sends remain visible.

intentionally_omitted: Provider names, routes, storage details, customer or account data, and finance-product implementation claims.
Claims about deployment, accuracy, savings, collection results, or real customer outcomes.
Accounting, tax, legal, or universal customer-contact advice.
